name: liquidity-state-carousel-machine
description: Liquidity State (@liquidity.state) carousel machine — one source page renders 7 carousel PNGs at 1080x1350, plus a brand-matched explanatory PDF lead magnet.

scripts.build: node scripts/render.js && node scripts/pdf.js && node scripts/qa.js

notes: Playwright + Chromium are provided by the environment (global). render.js and pdf.js resolve the global install; no local install or browser download is needed.
